description:
REXA, Inc is seeking a Product Engineer to develop actuator order and quote packages that capture the scope of supply, technical requirements, and all necessary details to produce a finished product. Scope of work includes creating all drawings, designing the adaptation hardware, adding customized accessories, generating a bill of materials and creating any instruction to the production floor. The Product Engineer will provide effective technical support to both internal and external customers as required on a job specific basis. 

  

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Develop actuator production packages to meet the order specification sheet

 Process orders with limited complexity under management/mentorship

 Utilize CAD design software to create customer specific actuator layout drawings

 Utilize of CAD design software to create custom adaptation hardware and components

 Generate bill of materials

 Generate special assembly or testing instructions for operations

 Interface with manufacturing to assist in the assembly and manufacturing of actuator packages

 Process Engineering Change Notices (ECNs)


 
  

 Qualifications: 


 
 Entry level; Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or equivalent experience

 Proficiency with Solidworks

 Ability to use Microsoft Office

 Ability to use ERP system for BOM generation and creation of new parts

 Possesses good problem-solving and critical thinking skills

 Ability to prioritize and multi-task

 Ability to technically communicate and execute concepts and ideas with cross functional team


 
 


 Working conditions 

 Office environment.  May be exposed to manufacturing activity.  No strenuous physical work.  Strict compliance with company safety policies. Occasional travel.

 


 We offer full benefits and competitive compensation. 

 Hourly range: $27.69 - $31.00 depending on experience 

 Benefits: 

 
 401(k) with company match 

 Health insurance 

 Dental insurance 

 Vision insurance 


 Flexible Spending Account 

 Health Savings Account 

 Life insurance 

 Paid vacation and sick time 

 Parental leave 

 Tuition reimbursement 

 11 company paid holidays 

 
 


 Equal Opportunity Employer - Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled 

 *This organization participates in E-Verify.*
